newsitem.title: USA: TMCI Electronics sees Q2 EPS $0.15 - $0.20.
newsitem.headline: TMCI Electronics sees Q2 EPS $0.15 - $0.20.

text.p: TMCI Electronics Inc said it expects sales for its second quarter will increase 25 percent over the first quarter, and earnings will be in the range of $.15 to $.20 per share.

The company said its recently improved acquisitions increased its gross margin in the first quarter by 8 percent, and that gains in sales over the fourth quarter of 1996 suggests its market is recovering from an industry slowdown in the second half of 1996.
Net income for the quarter ended March 31. 1997 was $306,862, or $.09 per common share, on sales of $7,4 million, compared with $31,219, or $.01 per common share, on sales of $7.7 million.
The 1996 quarter includes a non-cash finance charge of $.12 per common share.
